saa-ini-290.text: A company wants to collect click data from its site in real time and deliver it directly to Amazon S3, without managing servers, without writing consumer code and accepting a delivery latency of about 1 which service meets this scenario with the MENOR operational effort?
options: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with a consumer application in EC2
Amazon Kinesis Date Firehose with destination S3
Amazon SQS with a function Lambda Scheduled
AWS Glue with a streaming job
saa-ini-290.explanation: A) Incorrect: Data Streams requires you to build and manage the consumer application — more operational effort. B) Correct: Firehose is a service of ENTREGA fully managed: receives the stream, buffers and deposits in S3 automatically (near real-time, ~60(c) Incorrect: SQS is message queue, no streaming delivery service for the S3. D) Incorrect: Glue streaming processes data, but requires creating and maintaining a job — unnecessary when the goal is just delivering it to S3.

saa-ini-291.text: An IoT application needs to ingest thousands of events per second EM TEMPO REAL (the subsequent latency), allowing multiple consumer applications to read and process the same data flow independently. AWS is designed for this streaming intake?
saa-ini-291.explanation: A) Incorrect: no SQS, each message is consumed by ONE consumer and removed from the queue — there are no multiple readers independent of the same stream. B) Incorrect: Batch is for batch jobs, not streaming. C) Correct: Kinesis Data Streams ingests real-time events and allows several consumers to read the same stream independently, with replay within the retention period.: EventBridge Scheduler tasks (cron), do not ingest streams.

saa-ini-292.text: A development team wants to publish a Java web application on AWS just sending the code, without having to manually set up instances EC2, load balancer, Auto Scaling or monitoring — but maintaining access and control over these resources if you need to adjust them. What service does this experience offer??
saa-ini-292.explanation: A) Incorrect: Lightsail is a VPS simplified, without automatic provisioning of ALB/Auto Scaling orchestrated from code. B) Incorrect: CloudFormation provide infrastructure, but YOU need to write the templates of everything. C) Correct: the Elastic Beanstalk receive the code and automatically provide EC2, ELB, Auto Scaling and monitoring, keeping the resources visible and adjustable in your account. D) Incorrect: ECR is a container image registry, not an application deployment platform.

saa-ini-293.text: A company will migrate to the AWS a legacy application that communicates through ActiveMQ messaging protocols (JMS/AMQP). The team DOES NOT want to rewrite the application's message code. Which service allows you to migrate with the minimum of changes?
saa-ini-293.explanation: A) Incorrect: SQS use API of the AWS — would require rewriting the message layer.: SNS also uses API of the AWS, in addition to being pub/sub and not row broker with standard protocols.: Kinesis is for data streaming, does not replace a broker JMS/AMQP. D) Correct: or Amazon MQ is an ActiveMQ and RabbitMQ-compatible managed broker — the application continues to use JMS/AMQP/MQTT no code changes.

saa-ini-294.text: A company needs to transfer 500 TB of historical data for the Amazon S3, but your internet link is just 100 Mbps and the deadline is 3 Transferring through the network would take many months. AWS solve this problem?
saa-ini-294.explanation: A) Incorrect: Transfer Acceleration accelerates uploads over the internet using edge locations, but does not change the physical limitation of the link of 100 Mbps to 500 TB. B) Correct: or Snowball Edge is a physical device sent to the company; the data is copied locally and the device returns to AWS — the only option feasible in time for this volume with slow link.: DataSync optimizes the transfer, but remains limited by the available band. D) Incorrect: VPN does not increase the bandwidth of the contracted internet link.

saa-ini-295.text: A company wants to keep its on-premises file server accessible via NFS for local applications, but store the data in fact in Amazon S3, keeping in local cache only recently accessed files. Which service implements this hybrid scenario?
saa-ini-295.explanation: A) Correct: File Gateway exposes a sharing NFS/SMB local, store the data as objects in S3 and keeps local cache of hot files — exactly the hybrid described. B) Incorrect: DataSync MOVE/transfers data between on-premises and AWS; does not provide continuous hybrid access with cache. C) Incorrect: EFS is a cloud file system for loads in AWS, not a hybrid bridge with local cache. D) Incorrect: Transfer Family provides SFTP/FTPS managed on the S3 to exchange files with partners, not a hybrid server file.

saa-ini-296.text: A financial institution needs to carry out workloads at AWS, however regulations require data and processing to remain FISICAMENTE within your own datacenter, using the same APIs and services as the AWS. What solution meets this requirement?
saa-ini-296.explanation: A) Incorrect: Local Zones are infrastructure of AWS Incorrect: Dedicated Hosts are dedicated servers, but within the datacenters of AWS. (c) Correct: or Outposts takes hardware racks managed by AWS for DENTRO of the client's datacenter, with the same APIs and services — meeting data physical residence requirements. D) Incorrect: Wavelength incorporates data computing AWS Networks 5G of operators, turned to ultra-low mobile latency, not to customer datacenter.

saa-ini-297.text: When comparing the AWS KMS with the AWS CloudHSM, what is the main characteristic that differentiates the CloudHSM?
options: The CloudHSM is cheaper and totally without server
The CloudHSM provides a hardware module DEDICADO (single-tenant), with exclusive customer control over keys, validated FIPS 140-2 Level 3
The CloudHSM only works to encrypt buckets S3
The CloudHSM is the only option that integrates with the services of the AWS
saa-ini-297.explanation: A) Incorrect: CloudHSM is more expensive and involves dedicated hardware cluster — the KMS is that it is the low cost managed service. B) Correct: the CloudHSM offers dedicated HSMs of unique tenant, in which only the customer controls the keys, with validation FIPS 140-2 Level 3 — common requirement of strict compliance.: CloudHSM serves any cryptographic load (TLS Offload, PKI, bank keys), not only S3. D) Incorrect: is the KMS which has native integration with most of the services of AWS; o CloudHSM requires integration via standard libraries (PKCS#11, JCE).

saa-ini-298.text: Which ones DUAS statements on the Amazon S3 Are they correct? (Select DUAS alternatives)
options: The S3 Standard was designed for 99,999999999% (11 nine) of durability of the objects
The S3 is a block storage service attached to instances EC2
The versioning of the S3 allows you to recover objects accidentally overwritten or deleted
A Bucket S3 is restricted to the maximum 1 TB Data
The S3 requires pre-use capacity provision
saa-ini-298.explanation: A) Correct: the design durability of the S3 is of 11 nine with replicated data in multiple AZs. B) Incorrect: S3 is storage of OBJETOS; block is the EBS. C) Correct: with versioning, each overwritten generates new version and exclusions create a reversible marker delete. D) Incorrect: bucks have virtually unlimited capacity. E) Incorrect: the S3 is elastic — no previous capacity provisioning.

saa-ini-299.text: A company runs web servers in EC2 in a stable and predictable manner, 24 hours a day, more than a year ago, and wants to reduce the cost of computing. DUAS Do purchase options provide significant discount for this usage profile? (Select DUAS alternatives)
options: Computer Savings Plans with a commitment of 1 or 3 years
saa-ini-299.explanation: A) Incorrect: Spot can be interrupted at any time — unsuitable for servers that need to run 24/7 B) Correct: Reserved Instances They're even ~72% discount for stable and predictable use. C) Incorrect: On-Demand is the full price; Auto Scaling help with load variation, not with constant use discount. D) Correct: Savings Plans offer discounts equivalent to those of the RIs in exchange for commitment to spend per hour, with more flexibility. E) Incorrect: Dedicated Hosts meet licensing/compliance requirements and cost MAIS, Not less.

saa-ini-300.text: Which ones DUAS characteristics correctly describe the Security Groups in one VPC? (Select DUAS alternatives)
options: They are stateful: the return traffic of an enabled connection is automatically released
They operate at the subnet level, filtering all the traffic that enters it
Support only permission rules (allow), without explicit denial rules
Evaluate the rules in numerical order and stop in the first correspondence
saa-ini-300.explanation: A) Correction: Security Groups are stateful — the response of an enabled connection returns without the need for a corresponding output rule. Network ACL; the SG acts in the instance interface (ENI). C) Correct: SGs have only allow rules; to explicitly deny an IP, use NACL. D) Incorrect: evaluation by rule number is behavior of the NACL; the SG evaluates all the rules together. E) Incorrect: every instance has SG, in public or private sub-network.

saa-ini-301.text: A company wants to use the Amazon Route 53 for two objectives: (1) automatically direct users to a contingency site when the main site fails and (2) respond to users from the region with less latency. DUAS do routing policies meet these objectives, respectively? (Select DUAS alternatives)
saa-ini-301.explanation: A) Incorrect: Simple policy does not use health checks and does not contingency. B) Correct: Failover monitors the primary endpoint via health check and redirects to secondary when it fails. C) Incorrect: Weighted divides traffic by weights (e.g. A/B tests), not by latency. D) Correct: Latency-based responds with the lowest latency region endpoint for each user. E) Incorrect: Geolocation routes through the country/container of the user, not by site failure.
